

#####  #####

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)


############################# BENCHMARK Cache  ################################

# Set Working Directory
setwd("~/Documents/container_ditch-main/findings/Docker_ditch/Dicht/cache/")

# Import netperf file
cache<- readr::read_csv("cache_final.csv") 

# Format column types

cache$cache <- as.factor(cache$cache)    

## PLOTS ##

##################################### visualisation ######################################

p<- ggplot(cache, aes(x=cache, y=valeur_mean, fill=Environment,label=valeur_mean)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black",alpha=1,width=0.8,
           position=position_dodge()) +
  ##geom_text(mapping=aes(label=resultat_mean),size=6,position=position_dodge(.9),vjust=4.5) ### 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=valeur_mean-valeur_std, ymax=valeur_mean+valeur_std), width=.2,
                position=position_dodge(.9))+
  labs(x="Cache", y="Value")


p +theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = "top",legend.title = element_blank(),
                            legend.text = element_text( size = 40,color = "black"),
                            axis.text.x  = element_text(vjust=0.5, size=44,color = "black"),
                            axis.text.y  = element_text(vjust=0.5, size=44,color = "black"),
                            axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,color = "black",size=44),
                            axis.title.y = element_text(vjust=0.5, size=50,color = "black"))

ggsave("cache_final.pdf",width=25,height = 9)
